Author: Pankaj Mithal

 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Civil) No. 3493 Of 2024
 Samiunnisha Shamsul Haque Petitioner
 Versus
 Bismillah Bakhsullah Khan Respondent
 O R D E R
1.

The petitioner-wife is seeking transfer of a petition for restitution of conjugal rights filed by the respondent-husband bearing No.A/858/2024 titled as "Bismillah Bakhsullah Khan Vs.
Samiunnisha Shamsul Haque" pending before the Court of Principal Judge, District Judge (Family Court), Bandra, Mumbai- Suburban, Maharashtra to the competent court at Delhi(District North-West).
2.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
3. Despite service of notice being complete upon the respondent-husband, no one has entered appearance so far.

4. Considering the fact that two other cases filed by the petitioner: (i) D.V. Act Case No.21479 of 2023; and (ii) FIR u/s 498A, 406, 34 of IPC, are pending at Reason:
TP (CIVIL) NO. 3493 OF 2024 Delhi, it would be expedient for the ends of justice to transfer the subject-case as asked for by the petitioner-wife.
5. Accordingly, the subject case is transferred to Delhi (District North-West).
